interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with pedestrian warning signs to facilitate safe access to the building.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.
